thread:
Zoe: Quick announcement! Samira just got promoted to Senior ML Engineer and also dropped the surprise that she's expecting TWINS 🥳👶👶
Samira: ahhh thank you everyone ❤️ feeling very grateful and slightly terrified (in the best way)
Theo: WHAT 😭 double congrats! we need a double celebration (and double cake)
Ben: Congrats Samira!! Should we do a team card + group gift? I can start a Google doc to collect ideas/amounts
Carla: Love this. I'll organize a baby-shower signup and figure out timing with the team calendar. Any preferences (weekend vs weekday lunchtime)?
Samira: thanks! weekday lunchtime tends to work best for me. also low-key: no registry yet, we're doing a few essentials list — happy to share when ready
Priya: sending all the love! :heartpulse: also if anyone wants to chip in for a bigger gift let me know and I can collect
OpsBot: Reminder: company gift budget for life events applies. Submit expense via /gifts and tag @people-ops
Ben: I'll make the doc and include a quick poll for cake flavor and time. vanilla vs chocolate vs something fancy? :cake:
Theo: chocolate + salted caramel pls
Carla: +1 salted caramel
Zoe: I'll handle a little congratulatory banner on the #general header for the week :tada:
Samira: you all are the best. low maintenance please—just being with you all will be perfect :relaxed:
Priya: also can we get a tiny onesie with "Redwood Rookie" printed on it? 😄
Ben: omg yes
OpsBot: Event logistics note: please avoid scheduling the shower during the Q2 all-hands (calendar shows Q2 all-hands on 1799999600). Check conflicts before setting a date.
Carla: noted. I'll propose two dates in the doc and ping folks for quick votes.
Theo: congrats again Samira! going to miss you at the coffee cart if you're on parental leave soon but so happy for you :raised_hands:
Samira: will still come for the cart sometimes! but thank you all so much ❤️
